_doc: Cross-promotion registry. Brands, the CLAIMS made about them (each with a verification status and sourcing), and PROMOS that place a brand on a surface. Rendering is done by scripts/promo.mjs, which is independent of the bookstore so other sites can reuse it. A production build (FM_ENV=production) refuses to run while any placed promo is unapproved, has no URL, or relies on an unverified claim or an unauthorised badge. See docs/CROSS-PROMOTION.md.

nvidiaInception.note: Official NVIDIA Inception Program badge supplied by the owner from NVIDIA's member resources, copied byte-for-byte (SVG, unmodified; checked with cmp). IMPORTANT: the file supplied is the ONE-COLOUR BLACK variant (nvidia-inception-program-badge-rgb-1c-blk-for-screen.svg), not the full-colour 'nvidia-inception-program-badge-rgb-for-screen.svg' the owner asked for; the full-colour file and the Inception-specific guidelines document were not in the upload. Displayed at the same height as the IOSutra panel (99 px), so never larger, with its own built-in margin plus the site's clear space. licenseConfirmed is owner-asserted. guidelinesUrl is NVIDIA's general logo and brand page, which is all that could be read; the Inception badge guidelines PDF still needs to be checked, including the required trademark attribution wording (the current line, 'NVIDIA and NVIDIA Inception are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation.', is a standard form and is still marked needs-confirmation). To switch to the full-colour badge, copy that file into assets-src/partner/ and change `asset` here.
